remarks: Experience luxury living at 1 Broad Street in Stamford, where prime location meets top-tier amenities and stunning views. This apartment is bathed in natural light, featuring high ceilings and elegant white oak floors that create an inviting and spacious atmosphere. The renovated custom kitchen is a culinary delight, equipped with a marble island and backsplash, a paneled GE Monogram refrigerator, GE Cafe line stove and dishwasher, and brand-new LG washer and dryer. The two bedrooms each have en suite bathrooms, with the master suite boasting a walk-in closet and spa-like bathroom. The building enhances your lifestyle with an indoor pool, sauna, and white glove service. Enjoy the common areas and a rooftop BBQ area offering breathtaking city views of the Long Island Sound. Ideally located near restaurants, shopping, and transit, this luxury apartment provides an exceptional living experience for those who appreciate the finer things in life. Discover luxurious living at 1 Broad Street in Stamford.
